findings.title: Content stays invisible after scrolling the whole page
findings.evidence: 4 text/image elements still have opacity≈0 after a full scroll: section#top > div.hero__inner.container > p.eyebrow "Nordic architecture studio"; section#top > div.hero__inner.container > div.hero__foot > p.hero__lede "We design timber civic buildings and homes across the north "; div.hero__foot > div.hero__actions > a.btn.btn--solid > span "Selected work"; div.hero__foot > div.hero__actions > a.link-arrow > span "Our philosophy".
findings.fix: A reveal never fired. Check the IntersectionObserver targets/threshold (use threshold ≤0.15 and a negative bottom rootMargin, not 1.0), that every hidden element gets observed, and gate the hidden initial state behind a class added by JS (`.js [data-reveal]{opacity:0}`) so content is never lost if script fails.

findings.title: Text is clipped on mobile
findings.fix: Use fluid type (clamp()) and allow wrapping; never set overflow:hidden on a heading container sized for desktop.

findings.title: Text contrast is too low
findings.evidence: 8/183 checked text elements fail WCAG AA, e.g. "69.6492° N, 18.9553° E" 1.11:1, "Tromsø · Oslo" 1.11:1, "Scroll" 1.11:1.
findings.fix: Muted text still needs ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for 24px+). Raise lightness contrast of secondary text instead of lowering opacity.

findings.title: Copy scrolls underneath a sticky panel
findings.evidence: 3 text element(s) hidden behind a position:sticky element while in view. mobile scrollY 7319px: “We walk the site with the people who wil” is under the sticky div.process__sticky; mobile scrollY 8945px: “Panels are machined and assembled in a c” is under the sticky div.process__sticky; mobile scrollY 8945px: “Off-site build” is under the sticky div.process__sticky.
findings.fix: A pinned visual that sits beside the copy on desktop often stacks over it on phones. Below the breakpoint, unpin it (position:static) or give the copy its own full-height steps so it never shares the screen with the sticky panel.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 98 animations/transitions on height, marginLeft, margin-left, marginTop, margin-top; 0 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

findings.title: Hover feedback is sluggish
findings.evidence: 2 hover transitions last over 600 ms (e.g. body > header.site-header > a.brand > svg.brand__mark: 800 ms).
findings.fix: Hover/press feedback should start immediately and settle in 150–300ms; longer feels laggy under the pointer.

findings.title: Many elements loop forever
findings.fix: Limit ambient loops to one or two focal elements (a hero visual, a marquee). Constant motion everywhere competes with content and drains battery; pause off-screen loops.

findings.title: Tap targets are small on mobile
findings.evidence: div.hero__inner.container > div.hero__foot > div.hero__actions > a.link-arrow 132×32, article.card.card--land > div.card__meta > h3.card__title > button.card__open 168×35, article.card.card--port > div.card__meta > h3.card__title > button.card__open 131×35, article.card.card--port > div.card__meta > h3.card__title > button.card__open 104×35
findings.fix: Give touch controls at least 44×44px of hit area (padding or a pseudo-element hit box).

findings.title: Text is clipped on desktop
findings.fix: Allow wrapping or enlarge the container.

findings.title: The page looks like the default AI-built template
findings.evidence: It shares 7 of 9 traits of the landing page coding agents build by default: display face Instrument Serif, italic accent word in the headline, warm paper ground, small uppercase eyebrow above the headline, pill buttons, grain overlay, marquee.
findings.fix: Unless the brief asks for these, change at least four: a display face chosen for this subject, a ground and accent taken from its world, a hero built around one dominant element instead of headline-left/object-right, square or cut button shapes, and sections laid out from their content rather than eyebrow, marquee and bento. A page can earn every trait; it should not get them by default.

findings.title: Placeholder text is visible
findings.fix: Replace placeholder copy, .example addresses and zeroed phone numbers with plausible content (labelled illustrative where needed), or remove the line.
